title: Jesus dismisses the eastern tribes
english: [[Jesus calls Reubenites, Gadites, half-Manasseh — praises their obedience >> Bible:Joshua 22:1-6]]. Return to your tents with riches. Brotherly peace after shared war.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).

title: Altar of witness by the Jordan
english: They build a great altar by the Jordan — a scandal. [[Phinehas is sent >> Bible:Joshua 22:13]]. Not rebellion but witness: The Lord is our God.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).

title: Witness that the Lord is God
english: [[They named the altar Witness >> Bible:Joshua 22:34]]. Peace restored. One God on both banks. Amen.
